tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the limited status of one Duoly order with its revocable dos_ code. Never ask for a password. The code is private; do not repeat or put it in a URL.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Discover Duoly games for teammates and coaching. Use a returned id or slug in find_session.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Compare services with plain-language descriptions, from prices in EUR per unit, exact rank and region tokens and bookUrls. Share bookUrl so the user can book on Duoly.

tools.name: find_session
tools.description: Start here to find a player or coach. Returns up to three matching sessions with real calculated prices, descriptions, missing inputs and bookUrls to open Duoly. Use exact game, goal, rank and region tokens; errors list valid choices.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Use find_session for discovery and pricing. Compatibility tool for a selected service: calculate its base price before account perks. Required inputs: game, service, quantity (1..5, 20% off at 5), currency (EUR or USD), server, and rank for rank-priced services; Minecraft also needs edition.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check public availability context and positive online counts when available. A teammate accepts from the queue; counts do not guarantee a match.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Use find_session for discovery and pricing. Call create_booking_link only to produce a final booking link after the user selects a session. No order or payment is created.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_order_status" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read the limited status of one Duoly order with its revocable dos_ code. Never ask for a password. The code is private; do not repeat or put it in a URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status, list_services, find_session · Public sink: list_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status, list_services, find_session · Public sink: list_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get a real calculated session price and bookUrl for a selected service. Share bookUrl to review options and pay on Duoly. Base price before account perks." → after: "Use find_session for discovery and pricing. Compatibility tool for a selected service: calculate its base price before account perks. Required inputs: game, service, quantity (1..5, 20% off at 5), currency (EUR or USD), server, and rank for rank-priced services; Minecraft also needs edition."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_booking_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get a bookUrl that opens Duoly with the game and service selected. Share it for the user to review remaining options and pay on duoly.gg." → after: "Use find_session for discovery and pricing. Call create_booking_link only to produce a final booking link after the user selects a session. No order or payment is created."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
